summary: Identificación facial de hogar en conjunto cerrado: consentimiento, bóveda cifrada, plantilla por persona. Comodidad, nunca autenticación.
invariants: Every result carries authorizes:false; a face match never authenticates or authorises anything.
Enrolment needs active consent; a minor requires a parent or legal guardian who is a different person.
Templates live only inside an AES-256-GCM vault; raw photos and per-photo vectors are never stored.
Closed set: it only compares against consented, enrolled household members and never names strangers.
The embedder must be on loopback unless the host opts in explicitly.
reuseNotes: Import from src/index.ts and wrap with a thin adapter in each host product (Janus: packages/adapters/src/face-recognition-adapter.ts). Sibling of speaker-id; the two modules stay independent. Thresholds are model-dependent and uncalibrated: calibrate on the host.
